title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: The prototype demonstrates the confirmed input-only scope: image and audio in, text out.
Microphone capture, PDF image input, multimodal output, streaming, and model comparison are out of scope.
One image or one audio file is allowed per conversation history.
The browser validates file type, empty files, and size; the BFF performs temporary storage and base64 encoding.
Audio inference is represented as ASR transcription followed by a Responses API text request.
